title: Filter Even Numbers
description: Given an array of integers, return a new array containing only the even numbers, preserving order.
whatShouldHappen: If the element is even (divisible by 2 with no remainder), push it into the result.
patternExplanation: Build a new array by pushing only elements that satisfy a condition — the foundational pattern behind Array.prototype.filter.

title: Double Every Element
description: Given an array of numbers, return a new array where every element has been multiplied by 2.
whatShouldHappen: Push the element multiplied by 2 into the result.
patternExplanation: Apply a transformation to every element and collect the results — the foundational pattern behind Array.prototype.map.

title: Build Array from Permutation
description: Given a zero-based permutation nums (0-indexed), build and return an array ans of the same length where ans[i] = nums[nums[i]] for each 0 <= i < nums.length.
whatShouldHappen: Allocate a new array ans of length nums.length.
Iterate i from 0 up to nums.length - 1.
patternExplanation: Read values at index nums[i] and map them sequentially into the target buffer in O(n) time.

title: Concatenation of Array
description: Given an integer array nums of length n, return an array ans of length 2n where ans[i] == nums[i] and ans[i + n] == nums[i] for 0 <= i < n.
whatShouldHappen: Create an array ans of length 2 * n.
Populate ans[i] = nums[i] and ans[i + n] = nums[i].
patternExplanation: Writing to i and i + n in a single loop builds the doubled array with zero duplicate iteration overhead.

title: Pascal's Triangle
description: Given an integer numRows, return the first numRows of Pascal's triangle. In Pascal's triangle, each number is the sum of the two numbers directly above it.
whatShouldHappen: For each row index i from 0 to numRows - 1, create a row array filled with 1s of size i + 1.
For column indices j from 1 to i - 1, set row[j] = triangle[i-1][j-1] + triangle[i-1][j].
Push row to triangle and return triangle when done.
patternExplanation: Build 2D triangular structure row by row, referencing the previous row's adjacent cells to calculate interior elements.

title: Generate 2D Grid Coordinates
description: Given rows and cols, construct a 2D matrix of dimensions rows x cols filled with row-major sequential integers starting from 1.
whatShouldHappen: In an inner loop, iterate col from 0 to cols - 1, pushing counter++ into the current row.
Push each completed row into grid and return grid.
patternExplanation: Nested loops cleanly populate multi-dimensional matrices in row-major order with sequential indexing.
